top_diagnoses.diagnosis: Clear cell sarcoma of the scapula
top_diagnoses.reasoning_summary: The patient presents with a painful mass over the lower left scapula, restricted movement of the left glenohumeral joint, and a subcutaneous tender mass. Radiological examination shows an osteolytic lesion in the lower left scapula and a soft tissue mass with bone invasion. The open biopsy specimen and immunohistochemical stains are consistent with clear cell sarcoma of the scapula, including positive staining for S-100 protein and HMB-45, and negative staining for CD68, actin, and desmin antigens.
